description:
Blue dream is the latest project from The Rurals Andy Compton, written & produced in a studio on the Californian Coast (In LA) which is fully analogue, with retro drum machines, synths, filters and effects. The album is a collaboration with fellow groovers/studio owners Brad Kent and Irantzu Pujadas.
Expect a dose of psychedelic Cali' soul, with smooth grooves and warm feelings :)
